title: Prime Minister shares an article highlighting India’s inclusive development journey
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi, today shared an article by former President Shri Ram Nath Kovind highlighting how India’s development journey is increasingly bringing those who were unheard, unseen or underserved into the mainstream.
Shri Kovind highlighted the Prime Minister’s focus on the mantra of ‘Sabka Saath, Sabka Vikas’ and observed that the periphery is now moving to the centre of India’s development ambition.
The Prime Minister’s Office posted on X:
“Former President Shri @ramnathkovind writes that India's development story is increasingly bringing those who were unheard, unseen or underserved into the mainstream.
He highlights PM @narendramodi's focus on Sabka Saath, Sabka Vikas and says the periphery is now moving to the centre of India's development ambition.”
